### ✨ Seekers Notes Mod Menu (v2.82.2)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu for **Seekers Notes: Hidden Objects** by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **Unlimited Energy & Stamina (999 + 0 Cost)** — Locks player energy at 999 with 0 energy cost per location
- **XP & Coins Reward Multiplier (1x - 100x)** — Multiplies UserProfile.addExperience & UserProfile.addMoney rewards
- **Unlimited Coins & Gold** — Locks UserProfile.getMoney at 9,999+ and never decreases
- **Unlimited Rubies, Gems & Event Tokens** — Locks UserProfile.getCash & UserProfile.getTokens at 9,999+
- **Check Hook & Patch Status** — Verifies binary base address, active hooks & live patches

### 🛡️ Protection
- **1-User License**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
